name: @qti-pie/plate
description: qti-pie's plate, harvested from github.com/aidenzepp/qti-pie at f5365d6c2350442e429298e570b0fe1c64912136 (packages/plate/src, without its tests): opening, scoring and rendering QTI 3.0 assessments. Its two generated tables carry a declaration typing them unknown, as the one reader that decodes them through Schema takes them; without it TypeScript infers a literal type for 5.5 MB of JSON, which costs every typecheck that imports plate two minutes.
